scenes.text: This tutorial covers Platform installers. Install spaCR on Windows, macOS, or Linux without managing Python manually.
Open Platform installers from the spaCR section. Download the installer for your operating system from the current GitHub release.
In the main configuration area, review operating-system security prompts, the private runtime location, and the requested acceleration backend.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. Allow the installer to finish and preserve its install log if anything fails.
When the workflow finishes, use the native launcher while spaCR keeps its own managed Python runtime.
